meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把零散素材剪成品牌片、混剪或多场景长视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把手头素材剪成完整视频却找不到合适模板
copy.tagline_en: Cut brand reels, montages, and multi-scene videos from raw footage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn raw clips into a finished video without a ready template

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 HyperFrames 流程做自定义视频合成:多场景成片、品牌或 sizzle reel、蒙太奇、静态循环、静态字幕卡、素材混剪等。它先定故事线、设计与运动方案,再经分镜、预览和渲染审批逐步搭建。
howto.when: 当没有更专门的工作流可用,或 BRIEF.md 里 flow 设为 companion 时由它接管。新建项目要先走 /hyperframes 路由,只有 workflow 为 general-video 或 flow 为 companion 才回到这里。

say.text: 用 companion 模式和我一起做,先给我完整故事线和设计规格
say.note: 进入共创流程,你逐项确认

say.text: 帮我做一支多场景品牌短片,先查目录里现成的效果再定方案

howto.what_en: Claude authors or edits custom HyperFrames compositions — multi-scene pieces, brand or sizzle reels, montages, static loops, title cards, footage remixes. It plans, then builds through storyboard and render-approval gates.
howto.when_en: Takes over when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. New work routes through /hyperframes first; it returns here only for workflow: general-video or flow: companion.

say_en.text: Work with me in companion mode; start with the full story arc and design spec.
Make a multi-scene brand film; search the catalog for looks before planning.
say_en.note: Search registry first, hand-author only if empty
